purpose: Teach: 市中/汝/減退/ゴシップ/小声/快挙/真田/悪戯

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、市中、つまり市中の不審物情報を、警察、把握されますね
lines.en: So on this case, the police keep track of reports of suspicious objects around town, is that right?
lines.style: Careful student's question, tentative but precise, rising politely at the end, notebook-ready earnestness.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者が「汝の罪を悔いよ」と言ったお話、慎重に聴かれますね
lines.en: We do — and if a suspect says something like 'repent thy sins,' we listen to that account very carefully.
lines.style: Measured professional calm, even pace, a beat of gravity around the quoted words.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者の記憶減退を、警察、医師と確認されますね
lines.en: And if the victim's memory is declining, you confirm that together with a doctor, don't you?
lines.style: Quiet, respectful follow-up, slightly hushed on 'memory,' careful not to overstep.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、ゴシップ的な根拠不明情報には、警察、慎重に対応されますね
lines.en: That's right. With gossip — information with no clear basis — we respond very cautiously.
lines.style: Firm, reassuring cadence, slight emphasis on 'cautiously,' the practiced patience of a briefing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、目撃者の小声の証言を、警察、丁寧に拾われますね
lines.en: Even a witness's whispered testimony — you make sure to pick that up carefully, right?
lines.style: Voice dropping softer to mirror 'whispered,' genuine curiosity, gentle rising close.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯人検挙の快挙を、警察、控えめに発表されますね
lines.en: We do. And even when an arrest is a real triumph, we announce it modestly.
lines.style: Understated pride, dry half-smile audible, deliberately modest delivery matching the words.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者真田の前科を、警察、確認されますね
lines.en: And in this case, you'd check whether the suspect, Sanada, has any prior record?
lines.style: Leaning-in seriousness, crisp on the name, the cadence of ticking off a final checklist item.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、子供のいたずら、つまり悪戯通報にも、警察、丁寧に対応されますね
lines.en: We would. And even a report of a child's prank gets handled with the same care as anything else.
lines.style: Warm professional close, softening on 'child's prank,' unhurried, wrapping up the exchange kindly.
